subject: Follow-up: validating monthly token spend band & procurement gating for BrightWorks
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam@brightworks.ai>, Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@brightworks.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: validating monthly token spend band & procurement gating for BrightWorks

Hi Liam / Amelia —

Thanks again for the demo and the candid discussion today. Wanted to capture the numbers we discussed and the procurement constraints so we can put a short proposal and PO path in front of procurement next week. Quick summary from my side: 

What we heard from BrightWorks (confirm if any of this needs correction):
- Workload: customer-facing summarization + search reranking for knowledge base and chat.
- Estimated traffic profile: 3k–25k requests/day, average prompt + response ~600 tokens, bursty peaks in mornings.
- Monthly token estimate (range): ~20M to 120M tokens/month.
- Target unit economics: BrightWorks indicated a goal in the neighborhood of $600–$800 per 1M tokens (net price target).

Preliminary Redwood model mapping and expected monthly spend band (rough):
- Low case (20M tokens/mo): ~ $12,000/mo at $600/1M tokens.
- Mid case (60M tokens/mo): ~ $36,000/mo.
- High case (120M tokens/mo): ~ $72,000/mo.

Procurement gate / PO thresholds you flagged:
- Small buys (<= $25k/mo) — standard online ordering / card ok.
- Mid buys ($25k–$75k/mo) — procurement review + PO lead time (~2–3 weeks typical).
- Large buys (> $75k/mo) — legal + procurement, SLA/contract required (~4–6 weeks).

Next steps I propose (short timeline):
1) I’ll attach a compact cost estimate + a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) that calls out the three spend scenarios and the suggested pilot footprint. (attached)
2) Liam / Amelia: confirm which spend band you want us to price concretely (low / mid / high) and whether procurement requires a framework agreement vs single PO. Could you get me that by EOD Tue (5/19)?
3) Jordan / Karthik: once they confirm band, can you run pricing playbook and propose a committed vs on-demand option and a recommended $/1M target we can offer that fits Redwood internal approvals?
4) If procurement wants a PO and timeline, we’ll draft a short implementation timeline tied to billing start to ensure expectations line up.

Attachment stubs: RWI_estimate_BrightWorks_600perM_v1.pdf (2 pages); BrightWorks_mutual_action_plan_20260517.docx (MAP, 1 page)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that accelerates.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Liam Carter <liam@brightworks.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@brightworks.ai>, procurement@brightworks.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: validating monthly token spend band & procurement gating for BrightWorks

Thanks, Olga — this is a great recap and aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 20M–120M range is the right envelope. For budgeting, we should assume the mid case (60M) as the planning baseline, but procurement wants to see both low and high for risk.
- Our internal target net price to the product team is $650/1M tokens; procurement will push for lower but product is comfortable at that band if the SLA is there.
- Procurement note (procurement@brightworks.ai): for anything > $30k/mo we need a PO plus a one-off security questionnaire and a standard DPA. Lead time 2–4 weeks.

We’d like a single-sheet quote for the mid case at $650/1M and a breakdown that shows how the price changes at 20M and 120M. If you can also call out any available committed-usage discounts or a stepped-commit (e.g., start at $40k/mo for 3 months then ladder to $60k/mo), that helps.

Can you send that by Tue EOD? We’ll circulate to procurement.

Best,
Liam
Liam Carter
Head of Product, BrightWorks
liam@brightworks.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: validating monthly token spend band & procurement gating for BrightWorks

O — noted. Quick internal notes for the quote: 
- If they want $650/1M as a firm net target, we can build a 3-tier pricing sheet: 20M (base), 60M (preferred), 120M (volume). Recommend offering a 10% committed discount at the mid tier if they sign a 6-month commit.
- Procurement PO threshold: we typically flag anything > $25k/mo to Sales Ops for contract review; their 30k threshold is OK but we should plan internal approvals at $25k.
- Need to validate latency SLO expectations (we documented 95th percentile under 400ms in demo). If they require strict 99th percentile SLOs, that moves cost.

Action items for me: prepare price sheet and two MAP variants (one with 6-month commit ladder and one on-demand with higher unit cost). Shipping by Tue EOD PT.

-Jordan

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam@brightworks.ai>, Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@brightworks.ai>, procurement@brightworks.ai
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: validating monthly token spend band & procurement gating for BrightWorks

Liam / Amelia / Procurement —

Thanks — Jordan and I aligned overnight. Attaching the single-sheet mid-case quote and two MAP variants per Jordan’s note. Highlights in the attached PDF: 
- Mid-case (60M tokens): list price $720/1M, proposed net $650/1M w/ 6-mo commit (first 3 months at 80% of committed tier to allow ramp).
- Low-case / High-case line items included for PO budgeting (20M and 120M).
- Procurement note: if procurement confirms PO-only path we’ll prepare a short contract addendum and DPA; expected legal lead time 2–3 weeks once final price is accepted.

Next asks for procurement:
- Please confirm the threshold that will force a legal SLA review (you previously said > $75k/mo; procurement noted > $30k earlier). We need a single number to route approvals.
- If you want the committed-discount option, confirm that BrightWorks is comfortable with a 6-month minimum.

Proposed short MAP milestones:
- Tue 5/20 — BrightWorks confirms preferred band (low/mid/high) and procurement threshold.
- Fri 5/22 — Redwood sends final quote and draft PO-ready invoice.
- Mon 5/25 — Procurement issues PO or requests contract addendum (if required).

Attachments: RWI_estimate_BrightWorks_600perM_v1.pdf; BrightWorks_mutual_action_plan_20260517.docx

If helpful, I can loop Legal for a quick 15-min sync with procurement to accelerate the PO path.

Thanks all — looking forward to a short decision window.

—Olga
